contract.classifiableSignal: raised only, from exact cached already-focused tracked live window and actor
contract.fingerprint: all emitted Read scene fields except top-level serial, plus complete bounded window-actor inventory including hidden actors
contract.barrier: all existing non-raised signals unconditionally increment serial/non-raised barrier and invalidate cache, including away-back
contract.binding: epoch/serial/barrier and native focus/actor checked around synchronous getters and tracking
contract.refusal: missing/stale cache, unknown/dead/untracked inventory, changed guards/fields, getter failure, reentrancy, bounds, interval history gap, counter exhaustion
contract.diagnostics: separate SignalDiagnostics method; latest128 sanitized records plus first invalidation, dropped marker and overflow; no private field contents
contract.historyCoverage: fewer than128 prior records since cached Read; a new Read may start fresh covered interval at current serial despite older dropped history
contract.identityAllocation: Shared nextId must be a nonnegative safe integer below MAX_SAFE_INTEGER before any new actor/workspace ID assignment; cache cleared and assignment refused before storing unknown identity; existing IDs preserved.

limitations: Source tests only; no native input acceptance.
No complete painted composition or native event history outside subscribed signals.
Clutter allocation can be out of date outside paint.
nextGate: Review a fresh exact-artifact native fixture plan before extension/session changes or input; production input remains disabled.
